title: Vibraphone
summary: No vibraphone is rendered and there is no recording of one to compare with: the Iowa library has marimba and xylophone but no vibraphone.
physics_missing: A recording of a real vibraphone to grade against
Published aluminium-bar dimensions and undercut for one real instrument
Resonator tubes with their rotating fan valves, which give the vibrato
The tubular resonator coupling that the marimba also lacks
blocked: No reference recording and no published instrument description have been found; the bar slice built for the xylophone would be the starting point once both exist.
